chunks.text: # Phase46 sample doc This page documents handling of TS2322 errors when migrating to SvelteKit 2 and Bits-UI SSR. ## Steps 1. Ensure `npm run dev:quic` is running after Ollama endpoints are configured. 2. Configure Drizzle ORM migrations with Postgres and pgvector. 3. Enable UnoCSS and NES.css for consistent styling. ```ts // Example: src/routes/+page.svelte const value: string = 42; // TS2322 ``` ## Remediation - Cast numeric inputs with `String(value)` before assignment. - Update Svelte 5 components to use typed stores. - Verify Redis + Neo4j health via `/api/system/cluster-status`.

extractions.extraction_text: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'string'
Ensure variable is declared as string or convert the number to string
